g.text: Rectification changes waveform polarity while bridge load current keeps one direction

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal diode, resistive-load rectification; no forward drops, capacitor or transformer ratio included in normalized curves. Red paths identify alternate conducting
pairs. During L-positive half cycle, current goes L→D1→DC+→load→DC−→D4→R; opposite half uses D2/D3. Load polarity remains top positive in both panels.
